image_description: A small, slender snake with smooth, glossy scales is coiled in the palm of a human hand. The snake has a uniform golden-brown or yellowish-tan coloration on its dorsal side and a pale cream or white ventral side. Its head is small and rounded, barely distinct from the neck, with a visible dark eye. The body is cylindrical and worm-like. The background consists of the blurred skin texture of the hand holding the snake.
